name: Maravillas Abadía Jover - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities for 2025
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants the 2025 European Semester to focus on for jobs and social policy. It asks the European Commission and member states to do more to cut poverty and social exclusion, improve housing, help people with disabilities and Roma communities, invest in skills and training, and support quality jobs and fair wages. It also calls for new European plans on poverty, housing, mental health and homelessness. This is a set of recommendations, not a law.

- The Parliament asks for new European plans on poverty, housing, mental health and homelessness.
- It affects people at risk of poverty, disabled people, Roma, young people, families and workers.
- The Commission and member states are asked to act; nothing changes in law yet.
